wa.onb.needLanguage: Please pick one of the languages above.
wa.onb.disclosure: This is {site}. I am not a person — this is software, and what you write here is stored on this server and passes through WhatsApp (Meta) on its way to it. Nine short questions and the journal is yours. Write STOP at any time and I forget the answers you have given.
wa.onb.askEmail: What is your email address? It is the only address that can ever get into this journal, so it is the credential rather than a preference.
wa.onb.emailBad: That does not look like an email address.
wa.onb.askCode: I have sent a six-digit code to {email}. Type it here — it works for {minutes} minutes. If it does not arrive, send your address again and I'll send a new one.
wa.onb.mailFailed: The code could not be sent. Try again in a minute, or check the address.
wa.onb.tooMuch: That is as far as this number can go today. Try again tomorrow.
wa.onb.askTitle: What should the journal be called? It is the name on every page, and you can change it later.
wa.onb.titleBad: A name of two characters or more, please.
wa.onb.askUsername: And its address: {url}/… — lowercase letters, digits and dashes. This one is permanent, and it is the journal's own name rather than a trip's.
wa.onb.usernameBad: That cannot be an address: 2–31 characters, lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or a digit.
wa.onb.usernameTaken: That address is taken. Try another.
wa.onb.askNickname: And what should the site call you, {name}? Whatever you would like to read on your own pages.
wa.onb.askVisibility: Should the journal be public, or only for people you invite?
wa.onb.askReaders: You write in {language}. Should readers be able to switch the journal into another language as well? Yes means writing every day twice, in your own words — a day missing one is refused.
wa.onb.askCurrency: Last one: what do you count money in? Three letters — CHF, EUR, USD. This is the one thing that can never be changed afterwards, because every total in the journal is added up in it.
wa.onb.currencyBad: Three letters, please — the code rather than the name.
wa.onb.needChoice: Please tap one of the two.
wa.onb.needText: I need a typed answer to that question.
wa.onb.cancelled: Stopped, and your answers are forgotten. Write again whenever you like.

me.agentBody: Press the button below for a prompt to hand an agent — it already knows what to do with it.
me.agentTitle: To write, or to start a new trip
me.askOwner: There is nothing to fill in here — this journal keeps no guestbook. The link they send you is what lets you in.
me.askOwnerNamed: There is nothing to fill in here — this journal keeps no guestbook. It is kept by {name}: the link {name} sends you is what lets you in.
me.buddyAgent: To add days to this trip
me.buddyAgentBody: You were on the trip, so you can add days to it — the same way the journal's owner does, by handing the instructions below to an agent you started yourself. The agent asks this site for a code, and the code is emailed to you to read out.
me.buddyKeyBody: The key your agent ends up with works for seven days, on this trip and on nothing else in the journal. What it writes waits as a draft: putting a day on the site is a second call, and it belongs to whoever keeps the journal — not to you, and not to the agent.
me.buddyKeyWarning: Give the instructions to an agent you started yourself, never to a page or a chat somebody else sent you. To stop a key before its seven days are up, revoke it below yourself.
me.consentBody: Last agreed on {date}. Withdrawing one below stops it at once; the others are untouched.
me.consentNotGrantedNote: Not granted yet — only the helper's own question grants this.
me.dataLede: What this journal sends a model or the operator, and what you can do about it here.
me.deleteBody: This is the way out. It sends a link to the address that owns this journal — nothing is deleted until you press the button in that mail, and nothing can be put back afterwards.
me.deleteFailed: That did not work, and nothing has been deleted. Reload the page and try again.
me.deleteQuestion: Ask to delete “{title}”? {trips} journeys, {days} days and {files} files ({size}) would go. This only sends the link — nothing is deleted yet.
me.deleteSent: The link is on its way to {email}. It works once, for {minutes} minutes, and nothing is deleted until you press the button in that mail.
me.detailsBody: Your name, language and postal address are yours to change. Nothing else on this site can be edited here — the journal is written by an agent.
me.detailsBodyOwner: Your own details — name, telephone number and address. They decide where a postcard to you is sent, and how a published day reaches you. Sending to yourself costs nothing.
me.detailsBodyTraveller: Your name, language and postal address are yours to change. The journal itself is written by an agent — including the days you add to your own trip, further down this page.
me.handoverCreate: Get a key and the instructions
me.handoverFailed: The key could not be made. Try again.
me.handoverReady: Paste all of this into your agent. The key in it stops working at {time}, so do it now — after that, press the button again.
me.handoverWarning: This key becomes a seven-day key to write in your journal, the first time your agent uses it. Give it to an agent you started yourself, never to a page or a chat somebody else sent you.
me.inviteBuddyBody: Only for the people who were actually on the trip. Once you say yes, they can write to that trip and add to it, the same as you can. Do not put this one in a group chat.
me.inviteBuddyTitle: A link for someone to write
me.inviteGuestBody: Safe to send to the family. It lets somebody ask to read this journal, and nothing more — they see nothing until you say yes. When you say yes they get an email with a button that signs them in — that is what actually opens it for them.
me.inviteGuestTitle: A link for someone to read
me.journalBaseCurrencyNote: Set once, when this journal was created. A cost written with no currency IS a cost in the base currency, so changing it would not reconvert anything already recorded — it would silently change what every amount already written means. Ask for a new journal if it was wrong from the start.
me.journalCardBody: What the journal is called, which languages it offers, its units and currencies, and whether this server advertises it.
me.journalCurrenciesHint: Comma-separated three-letter codes a reader can switch totals into, e.g. CHF, EUR, USD. Must include the base currency.

me.journalEmailNote: This address decides who can get a key for this journal, which is why it cannot be changed here. Ask whoever runs the server.
me.journalFailed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

me.journalOwnerTelHint: Where your own copy of a published day is sent. Clear it to turn that off again. Costs no credits.
me.journalVisibilityConfirmGuest: Stop advertising this journal? It disappears from the landing page, the sitemap and /documentation.txt. Trip-level visibility is unaffected either way — a public trip stays reachable by anyone who already has its link, and a private one stays private.
me.journalVisibilityConfirmPublic: Make this journal public? Anyone who finds the link can read your public trips, and it appears on the landing page, in the sitemap and in /documentation.txt. Trip-level visibility is unaffected either way — a private trip stays private regardless.
me.journalVisibilityHint: Listed on the landing page, the sitemap and /documentation.txt. This decides only whether the journal is advertised — who may read one journey is still that trip's own visibility.
me.keysBody: One line per key you have handed out. Revoking one stops it at once — the agent holding it can no longer write, and nothing it already wrote is touched. An agent that is still working can renew itself before its seven days are up, and each renewal is a new line here: those end when you revoke them, not on their own.

me.title: Your access
me.tokenBody: A key from here — or a code you read out — becomes a key that works for seven days, on this journal and nothing else. It can write days, and it can put one on the site when you ask it to; everything it writes waits as a draft until you do. It is the whole of your editing, which is why it goes to somebody you trust and never into a group chat.
me.tokenWarning: None of it is the same as being signed in here. Reading your journal in this browser cannot change it — a key can, and anyone holding one can use it. A key lasts seven days, and an agent still working can renew itself before then, so revoking is how one ends for certain.

agent.helperConsent: This sends the words you typed above, and the facts already on this day — the date, the trip, the place, how many photographs — to Anthropic, who run the model. Nothing else goes: not your photographs, not your location history, not your contacts, not anybody's address, and not a trip you did not open. This is remembered for this journal until you withdraw it.

agent.askConsent: This sends what you type — and the rest of this conversation, for as long as it lasts — to Anthropic, who run the model. To answer, it may look up facts from this journal: your trips, what is unfinished, a day's own words, what a trip cost, your storage and your credits. Nothing else goes: not your photographs, not your location history, not your contacts, not anybody's address. It cannot change anything by itself. What it can do is propose — a trip, a day, its words, a cost, putting a day on the site or taking it off — and each of those is fields on your screen with a button you press; nothing is written until you do. It cannot delete anything at all, and it cannot send a postcard. Asking is free, and the one proposal that costs a credit says so before you press. Your words are not used to train anybody's model. This is remembered for this journal until you withdraw it.
agent.askUnknown: Nothing came back for that. Try saying it another way — or use the day helper, the trip form and the costs page, which do all of it by hand.
agent.slot.title: Title
agent.askRefuseRemove: Deleting is not something this conversation can do, and nothing has changed. A whole journal that you want gone finishes in your email, where the server sends a single-use link to a page with a button, and only that button deletes. A journey you can delete yourself, on its own page: signed in as the owner, the “Delete this journey” link sits under “Only you can see this”, and it asks once more — naming the days and photographs — before anything goes. If you meant taking a day off the site rather than destroying it, say that instead — a day can be taken down here, and nothing is lost by it.
agent.askRefusePublishAll: Publishing everything at once is not something this box does, and nothing has changed. A day goes on the site one at a time, after somebody has read it back — so say which day you mean, by its date or by what it is called, and the next answer shows you that day as your readers will see it, with the button underneath. If you are not sure how many are waiting, ask which days are still drafts and we will go through them one at a time.

Nothing else goes: not your location history, not your contacts, not anybody's address, and not a trip you did not open. It will not name a place it recognises, guess who anyone is, or guess a mood — only describe what is visibly in the frame, and it may say nothing at all. What comes back is shown to you to read and keep or discard; nothing is saved until you save it. This costs one credit per ten photographs, rounding up. Your photographs are not used to train anybody's model. This is remembered for this journal until you withdraw it, separately from consent to send your words.

The words come back into the box for you to read and change, and nothing is saved until you save it. It costs one credit per {minutes} started minutes. Your voice is not used to train anybody's model. This is remembered for this journal until you withdraw it, separately from consent to send your words or your photographs.

It costs one credit per {minutes} started minutes, same as the real thing, so testing the flow costs the same as using it. This is remembered for this journal until you withdraw it, separately from consent to send your words or your photographs.

agent.room.filesHint: Pick a few, then say what to do with them — “put these on yesterday”.
agent.open.oneDay: One day is not finished yet.
agent.open.clear: Everything is written and on the site — the last of it {date}. What would you like to do?
agent.open.finished: {title} is finished — {count} days, all on the site. Shall we make something of it?
agent.open.empty: Welcome. There is no trip here yet — tell me about yours and I will set it up.
agent.open.fresh: “{title}” is ready, and nothing is written in it yet. Tell me about your first day whenever you like.
agent.open.sayNewTrip: I want to start a new trip.
agent.open.sayNewDay: I want to write a new day.
agent.open.sayPhotos: Which days are still missing photographs?
agent.open.sayBook: I would like a photobook of {title}.
agent.open.sayCards: I would like to send postcards from {title}.
agent.open.sayInvite: I would like to invite somebody to read {title}.
agent.room.kept: Your conversations are saved so you can open them again. We read them to make Fernscout better — you can turn that off on your own page.
agent.room.noFiles: Nothing is waiting, and this trip has no photographs yet.
agent.room.pickAnyFile: Everything you choose waits above, under “Photographs” or “Documents” — photographs, videos, a bank statement, a location export (csv, gpx, json, pdf). Then tell me what to do with them.
agent.room.installHint: Only works in your default browser: Safari on iPhone, Chrome on Android.
agent.room.installStep1: iPhone, in Safari: tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”
agent.room.installStep2: Android, in Chrome: tap the menu → “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
agent.room.installStep3: Then open it from the home screen — it starts like an app
agent.room.installTitle: On your home screen, like an app
agent.room.dropHere: Drop to add to “What is waiting”
agent.room.attachNudge: Put the {count} new files on this day?
agent.room.attachNudge.one: Put the new file on this day?
agent.room.keysAgentWhole: Agent key, writes to the whole journal
agent.room.bringAgentIntro: Your own agent — ChatGPT, Claude, or any other — can write in this journal for you. Create a 20-minute access key, copy the prompt, and paste it into your agent.
agent.room.bringAgentMore: Manage keys on your own page
agent.room.lowCredits: Your credits are nearly used up — a few more written days.
agent.room.historyThisOne: The conversation you are in — nothing said yet
agent.room.uploadedWaiting: {count} files are waiting — tell me which day they belong to.
agent.room.uploadedWaiting.one: 1 file is waiting — tell me which day it belongs to.
agent.room.previewEmpty: Whatever you are talking about appears here, as your readers would see it.
agent.chat.title: Conversation
agent.tool.createTrip: A trip called {title}, from {start} to {end}. Nothing exists until you press.
agent.tool.visibilityPublic: Public — anybody at all can read it
agent.tool.visibilityGuest: Guests — everybody you have let into this journal
agent.tool.visibilityPrivate: Private — only the people who were on the trip
agent.tool.startDay: A day for {date} in {trip}. It starts empty; the words and the photographs come after.
agent.tool.startDayDone: The day is started. It is a draft, so nobody but you can read it.
agent.tool.startDayUnknown: The questions below open on “Nobody has it” — nothing is invented, nobody has been asked yet. Change one now, or tell me a real figure afterwards.
agent.tool.publishDayUnknown: One thing first: this trip keeps track of things this day says nothing about. The questions below open on “Nobody has it” — nothing is invented, nobody has been asked yet. Change one if you know the answer.
agent.tool.createTripVisibility: Read “Who may read it” before you press: guests are everybody you have let into this journal, and private is only the people who were on the trip itself.
agent.tool.editTrip: {title}, {start} to {end}. Nothing changes until you press.
agent.tool.setVisibilityDone: Who may read it has changed.
agent.tool.tripPeople: {name} joins the byline of {trip} — and can then write to the whole trip, not just read it.
agent.tool.tripPeopleNeedsEmail: I need their name and their email address before I can put this in front of you — say both and I will make the card.
agent.tool.tripPeopleDone: They are on the trip, and may now write to it.
agent.tool.tripTracks: What every day of {trip} is asked for. Turning a row off does not touch anything already written.
agent.tool.setReminderOn: An evening reminder for {trip} — one nudge, on a day nothing has been written yet, only while the trip is running.
agent.tool.setReminderOff: Turn off the evening reminder for {trip}. No more nudges.
agent.tool.draftWords: Your notes for {date}, turned into a title and a few paragraphs. Nothing is added that you did not say, you read it before any of it is kept, and it costs {credits} credit.
agent.tool.draftWordsDone: That is what it made of your notes. Nothing is saved yet.
agent.tool.setWords: The title and the words of {date}.
agent.tool.whichDayToRewrite: Which day do you want me to rewrite? Say the date, or what the day was about — that one already has words on it and I would rather not replace the wrong ones.
agent.tool.addCostDone: It is on the day's costs.
agent.tool.setRateOutside: {amount} is currently outside the total and will join it once this is saved.
agent.tool.setRateDone: The rate is saved. Costs in that currency now count.
agent.tool.setBudget: A budget of {total} over {days} days, for {trip}.
agent.tool.setBudgetEmpty: I need a total and how many days, or something paid for before leaving and how much.
agent.tool.publishDay: {date} — “{title}”. Read it as your readers will see it. Pressing puts it on the site.
agent.tool.publishReadersPublic: Anybody who finds it will be able to read it.
agent.tool.publishReadersGuestNobody: Only you. This trip is open to the people you let into your journal, and you have not let anybody in yet — so nobody else can read it until you invite somebody.
agent.tool.publishReadersGuest: You, and the {count} people you have let into your journal.
agent.tool.publishReadersPrivateNobody: Only you. This trip is open to the people who were on it, and nobody is named on it.
agent.tool.publishReadersPrivate: You, and the people on the trip: {people}.
agent.tool.attachFiles: {count} photographs from the inbox go onto {date} — “{title}”. They leave the inbox and belong to the day.
agent.tool.attachFiles.one: 1 photograph from the inbox goes onto {date} — “{title}”. It leaves the inbox and belongs to the day.
agent.tool.attachNone: I could not find those photographs waiting in the inbox, or the day to put them on. Select them in the files pane and say which day.
agent.tool.removePhoto: This photograph from {date} — “{title}”. It comes off the day and off disk — the picture and its kept original both — and there is no undo.
agent.tool.removePhotoNone: I cannot tell which photograph you mean. Tick it in the files pane, or say which day and I can show you what is on it.
agent.tool.removePhotoDone: It is gone — the picture and its kept original both.
agent.tool.discardFile: The file waiting in the inbox: “{filename}”. It leaves the inbox for good.
agent.tool.discardFileNone: I cannot tell which file you mean. Tick it in the files pane and try again.
agent.tool.discardFileDone: It is gone from the inbox.
agent.tool.discardFileMany: The {count} files waiting in the inbox — {size} together. They leave the inbox for good.
agent.tool.discardFileManyDone: They are gone from the inbox.
agent.tool.publishNoDay: There is no day here to do that with. Say which one you mean — a date, or what it is called.
agent.tool.unpublishDay: {date} — “{title}” comes off the site and goes back to being a draft. Nothing is deleted: the words and every photograph stay, and you can put it back whenever you like.
agent.tool.alreadyDraft: That day is already a draft — it is not on the site, so there is nothing to take down.
agent.tool.alreadyPublished: That day is already on the site — there is nothing to publish again.
agent.tool.unpublishDayDone: It is off the site and back to a draft. Nothing was deleted.
agent.tool.noTrip: I cannot tell which trip you mean, so there is nothing to press yet and nothing has been saved. Say the trip by its name — or make it first, and then this can go in it.
agent.tool.noDay: There is no day in your journal for that date yet, so nothing has been saved and there is nothing to press. Start the day first, and then this can go on it.
agent.tool.noFiles: I cannot find those photographs waiting in the inbox, so nothing has moved and there is nothing to press. Tick them in the files pane and say which day again.
agent.nothingHappened: Nothing has been saved and nothing has changed in your journal — there is nothing waiting to be confirmed. Say it again, or say which trip and which day you mean, and I will put something in front of you to confirm.
agent.noScreenHere: This is a chat, not a page — there is nothing to point at but this message. If something is waiting, its buttons are right here; if I sent a link, it opens the room, it is not already open.
agent.notUntilYouPress: That is waiting to be confirmed and nothing has been saved yet — confirming it is what makes it so. Read it, and confirm it if it is right.
agent.noWordsProposed: There are no words on that yet — what is waiting is an empty day with its date. Press it, and then tell me about the day and I will write it up.
agent.noAccessYet: I cannot tell you that somebody can read this. A trip that is not public is open to the people who were on it and to the guests you have approved — naming somebody does not let them in. Say who should read it and I will put a link in front of you to send them.
agent.notRead: I have not read that day in this answer, so I cannot tell you what it says — and I will not guess at somebody's own words. Say it again and I will open the day and quote it back to you.
agent.notCounted: I would rather not give you a figure I have not added up properly — a wrong number about your own money is worse than none. Ask me again and I will read the costs first.
agent.theListIsAbove: Take a look at the options already given — pick one.
agent.stillHasAQuestion: I think I only got to part of what you asked — go ahead and ask the other part again and I will look into it properly this time.
agent.tool.addPhotos: Photographs go on from the day's own page, where the picker and the upload are.
agent.tool.addPhotosPane: Photographs go in right here: the paperclip beside the field (or the Dateien tab) opens the files pane — choose them there and they land under “What is waiting”. Then tell me which day they belong to, and I will put them on it.
agent.tool.inviteGuest: A link to send to whoever should be able to read this journal. It lets nobody in on its own: whoever opens it proves their own address and then appears in your list, and they can read nothing until you approve them. The name below is only so you can tell whose link it is.
agent.tool.inviteGuestDone: Here is the link — send it to them yourself, however you like. When they open it they can ask to be let in; they still cannot read anything until you approve them on your contacts page. After you approve them they get one more email — the one with the button that actually signs them in. That is the last step, and they need it.
agent.tool.revokeInvite: Take back this {kind} link. Anybody already approved through it stays in — this only stops it being used again.
agent.tool.revokeInviteDone: The link is revoked. Everybody already approved stays in.
agent.tool.noInvite: That link could not be found — ask to see the list first, or say which one.
agent.tool.tellReadersDraft: That day is still a draft — publish it first, and there is nothing to tell anybody about yet.
agent.tool.tellReadersMail: {date} — “{title}” goes out as a letter to {count} people. It costs nothing.
agent.tool.tellReadersWhatsapp: {date} — “{title}” goes out on WhatsApp to {count} people. It spends {credits} credits.
agent.tool.channelsOn: Turn {channel} on for this journal. Its letters and messages start going out again.
agent.tool.channelsOff: Turn {channel} off for this journal. Nothing more goes out until you turn it back on.
agent.tool.channelUnavailable: This server does not offer that channel at all, so there is nothing to switch.
agent.tool.journalSettings: The journal's own title and tagline. Nothing about who may read it changes.
agent.tool.cleanup: A cleanup would take {bytes} across {files} files — generated photobook PDFs and postcard sheets, nothing else.
agent.tool.cleanup.one: A cleanup would take {bytes} across 1 file — generated photobook PDFs and postcard sheets, nothing else.
agent.tool.cleanupDone: That space is free. Every day and photograph stays exactly where it was.
agent.tool.cleanupPreview: Every day and photograph stays. Only generated photobook PDFs and postcard sheets go, and both can be built again.
agent.tool.nothingToClean: There is nothing generated to clear right now — no spare photobook PDF, no postcard sheet.
agent.tool.buyRoomDone: Bought. The journal may now hold 5 GB more.
agent.tool.buyRoomPreview: {credits} credits (about {price}) buys 5 GB more. This journal has {balance} credits.
agent.tool.creditsOff: This server does not charge for anything, so there is nothing to buy.
agent.block.keys: Keys that can write to this journal
agent.tool.revokeKey: Take back this {kind} — it stops being able to write here immediately.
agent.tool.revokeKeyDone: It can no longer write here.
agent.tool.noKey: I do not have a key matching that. Ask for `keys` again and say which one.
agent.tool.buyCredits: Buy more credits, and see the balance and the price, on the journal's own page.
agent.block.postcardRecipients: Who a card could go to
agent.block.postcardTexts: What each day could say on the back
agent.tool.postcardsUnavailable: This journal has not switched postcards on, so there is nothing to propose.
agent.tool.postcardsTestDay: That day is marked test: true — content nobody lived — so it cannot go on a card.
agent.tool.postcardsNoPhoto: That day has no photograph to put on a card.
agent.tool.postcardsUnknownRecipient: Nobody on that list is on postcard_recipients — look up their id there and try again with that, not a name.
agent.tool.postcardsNoSignature: A postcard needs a signature. Ask who it should say it's from, then try again.
agent.tool.proposePostcards: {count} cards from {date} — “{title}”, at {each} credits each ({total} total). Your balance is {balance} credits. Nothing is printed until you press.
agent.tool.proposePostcards.one: 1 card from {date} — “{title}”, at {each} credits each ({total} total). Your balance is {balance} credits. Nothing is printed until you press.
agent.tool.proposePostcardsFree: {count} cards from {date} — “{title}”. This server charges nothing for printing. Nothing is printed until you press.
agent.tool.proposePostcardsFree.one: 1 card from {date} — “{title}”. This server charges nothing for printing. Nothing is printed until you press.
agent.tool.proposePostcardsDone: A preview is waiting on your postcards page, with the price and your balance. Nothing has been printed.
agent.tool.photobookUnavailable: This journal has not switched photobooks on, so there is nothing to propose.
agent.tool.photobook: A {size} book of {trip}, {cover} cover. This hands over the page where the pages are laid out, priced and paid for — nothing is built or charged here.
agent.tool.photobookDone: A link to your photobook page is waiting. Nothing has been built or charged.
agent.chat.leftIt: Left as it was. Nothing was written and nothing was charged.
agent.chat.orSayWhatIsWrong: Or say what is wrong — “no, the 14th” — and it comes back changed.
agent.chat.reopenedPending: The card for this is gone now — {kind} — never pressed. Say it again if you still want it.
agent.chat.reopenedDone: The card for this is gone now. It was pressed, and it went through.
agent.card.confirmDestroy: There is no undo. Press again to go ahead.
agent.slot.label: What it was
agent.slot.name: Who it is for
agent.statementConsentShort: Sends this file's heading row and its first five rows to a model, so it can say which column is which.
agent.pickPhotosWhy: What the camera recorded — the day, the time and where you were — fills in the rest, and nothing is invented from it.
postcard.result.providerFailed: The printer refused every card, so nothing was sent and your credits have been given back.
credits.worth: One credit is about {one}; {credits} credits cost {price}.
cost.addHint: One receipt at a time. Nothing here is guessed — if you do not know, leave it.
cost.addNone: Nothing has been written down for this day yet.
cost.addNoDay: There is no day written for {date} yet, so there is nothing to put this on. Write that day first.
agent.assumed: For now this day says {fields}. Nothing was invented — nobody has been asked yet.
agent.assumedCosts: nobody wrote down what it cost
agent.assumedCoordinates: nobody wrote down where it was
agent.assumedPhotos: nobody has the photographs to hand
agent.localeLabel: Which language do you write in?
agent.localeHint: Your journal's own language — the site's menus around your words, and the emails this server sends you.
agent.readerLocalesLabel: Can a reader switch it into another language?
agent.readerLocalesHint: Tick a second language only if you will write every day twice. Every day of every trip then has to exist in all of them, in your own words, and a day missing one is refused. One language is the honest answer, and it can be widened later.
agent.currencyLabel: Which currency do you count in?
agent.currencyHint: A three-letter code — EUR, CHF, HUF, USD. Everything a trip costs is added up in this one. It cannot be changed after the journal is made.
agent.ownerNameHint: It appears on your trips as the person who kept them. “Robin Traveller”.
agent.ownerNicknameHint: The short form the site uses when it speaks to you or about you — “Robin”. Usually your first name, and it may be the same as above.
agent.ownAgentOptional: Already using something like ChatGPT? You can hand it this — otherwise you do not need any of it.
publish.head: "{title}" ({date}) is on {url}.
publish.tail: Taking it down again removes it from the site, not from the people who have already read it.
publish.closed: The trip is {visibility}, so it can be read by {who}, and by nobody else.
publish.whoGuest: you and the people you have approved into this journal
publish.whoPrivate: you and the people listed on the trip
publish.testClosed: It is marked test: true — content nobody lived — so the page says so in a banner.
publish.testPublic: It is marked test: true — content nobody lived — so the page says so in a banner and it is kept out of the feed, the search index and the sitemap. Anyone with the link can still read it.
publish.unlisted: It is in the journal and anyone with the link can read it, but the trip is listed: false, so it is kept out of the feed, the search index and the sitemap — it is found by being given the link, not by looking.
publish.listed: It is in the journal, the feed and the search index, and anyone with the link can read it.
pricing.title: What it costs
pricing.lede: Fernscout is free. You only pay for what costs us money ourselves — and only when you ask for it.
pricing.freeGrant: {credits} credits as a gift, to start
pricing.freeGrantDetail: worth {value} — enough for your first {credits} written days
pricing.freeEmail: Email to your readers, every day you publish
pricing.freeAgent: Bring your own agent, through the API — writing is free that way
pricing.freeMaps: Weather, maps and your own GPS tracks
pricing.creditsLede: Paid in advance, cheaper the more you buy at once — and it never expires.
pricing.rowHelpDetail: Per finished day, the whole conversation included — likewise {photos} captioned photographs, {minutes} minutes of speech, or one bank statement read. With your own agent it is free
pricing.rowWhatsappDetail: To family and friends when a new day goes online — not chatting with your agent
me.spentAiNote: Write-ups and transcriptions are produced by an AI model — Fernscout sends what you describe to the model and charges one credit per request.
me.buyDialogNoDiscount: From {from} to {to}. The more you buy at once, the less each one costs.
purchase.receipt.subject: Receipt — {credits} credits
purchase.receipt.title: Thank you for your purchase
purchase.receipt.body: Your payment went through and {credits} credits have been added to your journal.
purchase.receipt.footer: Sent because credits were bought for your journal. Keep this as your receipt; quote the reference above if you need an invoice for your books.
purchase.refund.subject: Refunded — {amount}
purchase.refund.title: Your purchase was refunded
purchase.refund.body: {amount} has been refunded to the way you paid. Depending on your bank it can take a few days to appear.
purchase.refund.credits: {credits} credits have been taken off your balance again.
purchase.refund.creditsNone: The credits had already been used, so nothing was taken off your balance.
purchase.refund.footer: Sent because a purchase on your journal was refunded. Reply to this message if anything looks wrong.
pricing.rowPhotobookPrintDetail: Your whole trip as a book, printed near the recipient and posted to whoever you choose. The price depends on the size, the page count and where it goes, and you see it before you order
pricing.creditNote: Fernscout counts in credits behind the scenes: 1 credit = {one}, and your {grant} gift credits are worth {grantValue}. Buy from {min} at a time; on larger purchases the price per credit falls as low as {best}.
edit.heading: Correct this day
edit.body: Your words, as they are on the page. Saving writes them straight to the journal.
edit.title: Title
edit.failed: That did not save. Nothing has been changed.
edit.caption: Caption
edit.tripListed: Advertise this trip — sitemap, feed and switcher
edit.takeDown: Take this day off the site
edit.takeDownQuestion: The day goes back to being a draft: it leaves the site, the feed and the sitemap, and nobody but you can read it. Nothing is deleted — the words and every photograph stay exactly as they are, and you can put it back on the site whenever you like.
agent.speechTooShort: That was too short to send — hold the button, or press it once to start and again to stop.
postcard.startsFromNothing: This day has no words yet — you can write the card from scratch.
postcard.writeNext: You write the card on the next screen, where you can see it at print size.
agent.askHereHint: Change it, add photographs, put it on the site — one tap starts the conversation.
agent.about.offer: This day is in the preview. What should happen to it?
agent.about.rewrite: Rewrite the words of this day
agent.about.addCost: Add a cost to this day
agent.about.publish: Put this day on the site
agent.about.unpublish: Take this day off the site
agent.publishRowHint: Nobody but you sees the day until you say so.
agent.room.roomLinkHint: Your files and a preview of the day, beside you.
notify.question: Send this day now?
wa.speechConsentAsk: Voice notes are transcribed by Deepgram, a separate company from the one that writes your days. Reply 'yes' to let me listen to this one — I'll ask again for the first voice note only.
wa.speechConsentGranted: Thanks — send the voice note again and I'll listen to it.
wa.voiceTooLong: That recording is longer than I can take — {maxMinutes} minutes at most. Send a shorter one.
wa.mediaLanded: Got it — {count} waiting in your inbox. Tell me which day it belongs to and I'll put it there.
wa.mediaTip: One thing worth knowing: a photo sent as a photo is compressed by WhatsApp and loses its date and location. Send it as a document (the paperclip, not the camera) for the full-resolution original with its real details intact.
wa.videoNotSupported: Video isn't supported here yet — send the photos separately, or write about it and I'll note it down.
wa.locationPinCreated: Got your location — I've started a draft day for {date} in {title}, with just the coordinates. Tell me about it and I'll fill it in.
wa.locationNoTrip: That location is for {date}, and I can't find a trip that covers that date. Tell me which trip it belongs to.
wa.locationIncomplete: I have your location, but {title} needs a bit more before I can start a day — tell me about it in words and I'll try again.
wa.locationAttached: Got your location — I've added the coordinates to {date} in {title}.
wa.mediaDownloadFailed: I could not download what you just sent — could you send it again?
wa.enrichLocation: Where was this? Send a location pin whenever you have one, and I'll add it.
wa.enrichCosts: Anything to log for what this cost? Tell me whenever you're ready.
wa.contactNeedsEmail: I'd need an email address for {name} to make an invite — that contact card didn't have one. Send it again with an email, or tell me theirs.
wa.stopReply: To stop these messages, open this link and press the button there — that is what unsubscribes you, and you can change what you get on the same page: {url}
wa.proposalGone: There's nothing waiting to be pressed right now — that button may already have been used, or something newer has come up since.
wa.proposalWebOnly: That one needs the web — open the journal to finish it there.
wa.proposalFailed: That couldn't be saved ({error}) — open the web to try again.
wa.newChatStarted: Started a fresh conversation — the earlier one is still in your history at {url}.
agent.tool.undoWords: {date} — put back the words as they were before the last change.
agent.tool.undoWordsDone: The previous words are back. Pressing this again would undo it.
agent.tool.lookUpWeather: {date} — look this day's weather up in the public archive, at its own coordinates.
agent.tool.lookUpWeatherDone: Asked the archive. Whatever it answered — or if it had nothing yet — is on the day now.
